messages:
alex: Customer surprised by 12x unit variance when they mixed 128d and 1536d embeds in one batch. They asked why cost is so uneven.

maria: We only surface aggregate token metrics in Console today. No per-request unit guidance.

sam: Preflight already computes a routing estimate. We could expose X-Embed-Estimate-Units + a compact dims bucket string for debugging. Need clear "not billing" label.

julian: UX: show units, per-item avg, and dims histogram (example: 128:4,1536:1). That will make mixed-dim penalty visible.

ingress-bot: Proto header currently: X-Embed-Estimate-Units: 3120; X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN: tokens=12480;buckets=128:4,1536:1;pad=128

maria: Console plan: behind feature flag console.embed_estimates_v1. Add request details with sample header parse and a route-level p50/p95/p99 units chart. Tooltip: "Estimated units 12 guidance only, not invoiced."

sam: Perf note: breakdown per item is O(n). We'll compress into dims buckets for the header, keep full JSON in internal logs. Emit metrics ingress_embed_estimate_units_sum and histogram with labels tenant_id, route, dims_bucket.

julian: Dashboard filter: filter by dims_bucket to surface which requests drive high units. Also add an anomaly alert for sudden rise in avg units.

alex: Security: we're not shipping payloads, only counts & computed numbers. Good to check with security if anyone disagrees.

devex-bot: Pseudo snippet: ```python
units = sum(estimate(it) for it in batch)
buckets = bucket_dims(batch)
resp.headers['X-Embed-Estimate-Units'] = str(units)
resp.headers['X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN'] = f"tokens={tokens};buckets={','.join(f'{k}:{v}' for k,v in buckets.items())};pad={pad}"
metrics.histogram('ingress.embed.estimate_units', units, labels=labels)
```

maria: Action items: Sam - expose headers + Prom metrics behind flag. Maria - Console UI + tooltip + chart. Julian - docs snippet and alert rule. Alex - run canary and customer FAQ. Timeline: internal canary in 5 days, opt-in beta in 2 weeks.

alex: Thanks all. Ping here if any edgecases pop up. :thumbsup:
